canonAmendment: RATIFIED by Erik 2026-07-19. The founding claim 'every craft in this world is nanite-mediated' is NO LONGER UNIVERSAL. Some power is natural — body, breath, growth, grief, craft-of-hand — and is not lattice-mediated at all. ⛔ SUPERSEDED IN PART, 2026-08-08 (SNG-376/377/378): lattice and nanite are SEPARATE (different builders, different eras); `natural` split into `body` and `metaphysical`, which want different ground; `veil` added as a source powered by an ABSENCE. ⚠️ THE REBASE BELOW IS NOT A RENAME — seraphic, abyssal and numinous changed PRIMARY on Erik's rulings, and god_named and bargainers were authored for the first time. 26/26 traditions now carry a mix.
ruling_natural_benefits: Erik 2026-07-19: natural craft BENEFITS from a thin lattice, not merely goes unpenalised. The Quickwood is not the Returned's tolerable ground — it is their BEST ground. This is what makes them equal rather than compensated.

sources.precursor: The Precursor lattice — the built substrate that reads structured will. Alien, ancient, still obeying instructions nobody living gave it. Two-sided band {0.90, 0.20}: dense ground helps until it interferes. ⚠️ It is WAR INFRASTRUCTURE (SNG-377): built by one side of a conflict that has not ended.
sources.metaphysical: Mind reaching past matter, opened by the Transition. Band {0.15, 0.22} — ⚠️ it WANTS THIN GROUND: a dense lattice is apparatus standing between the practitioner and the thing itself. The OLDEST way, and the one the lattice was built to replace. (Was `inherent`.)
sources.veil: ⛔ POWERED BY AN ABSENCE, NOT A SUBSTANCE. The Veil is a defensive work; thinning it opens a breach. Band {0.10, 0.20} — the MIRROR of precursor, because thinning one strengthens the other. ⚠️ Rare by design: most traditions must not have this, and its scarcity is characterisation.
sources.combination: Two or more sources at once, scaled by mix — ⛔ NEVER rounded to the dominant one. Erik's case: nanite moves the cup, metaphysics aims it, and thin ground helps one half while hurting the other IN THE SAME ACTION.
sources._bodyRemoved:
⛔ SNG-487: `body` REMOVED AS A SOURCE. Superseded by the 2026-08-15 four-source allocation, where it was absorbed into `metaphysical` as innate Ki. ⚠️ IT REMAINED IN THIS BLOCK FOR A DAY AFTER BEING RULED OUT, AND I REACHED FOR IT — a stale definition is an invitation. Its old text: 'body, skill, stone, edge, breath, years; reaches for nothing, so nothing can be taken from it — a FLOOR, flat at every density.'
⚠️ THE FLAT-FLOOR PROPERTY IS WORTH KEEPING as a quality of innate metaphysical craft, not as a separate source.
sources.ordered_nanite: ⛔ SEPARATE FROM THE LATTICE (Erik 2026-08-08). Machinery deployed BEFORE the Transition, still running to its old specification — human-made, younger than the Precursors. It goes where its makers put it and where people carry it, so it answers to CONDITION AND SUPPLY, not to ground: no band, no floor. It fails by breaking, and breakage is mechanical and repairable.
sources.wild_nanite: Ungoverned nanites — the Wild Half's tangled current. Widens BOTH crit bands (SNG-140). Band {0.32, 0.34}; thrives in the unreached gaps.
sources._nanieStates: ⛔ ORDERED AND WILD ARE ONE SOURCE IN TWO STATES. Rootkin and Churnfolk break ordered → wild; Seraphim and Enginewrights order wild → ordered. ⚠️ THAT CONVERSION IS A LIVE FACTIONAL ARGUMENT OVER A SHARED RESOURCE, not two peoples using different materials.

theTwoCurrents._ruling:
⛔ ERIK, 2026-08-23: 'We need to REWRITE what the wild_current and living_current are so they can be EXPLAINED BY THESE POWER SOURCES (and their combinations).'
⚠️ BOTH WERE AUTHORED AS SEPARATE DEEP-POWER FAMILIES — SNG-131 and SNG-140 — and both are actually COMBINATIONS. ⛔ THEY ARE NOT A FIFTH AND SIXTH SOURCE. They are two places where a pair meets, and naming them that way explains what was previously just asserted.

wild_current.what: ⛔ THE WILD HALF'S TANGLED CURRENT — ungoverned nanite carrying unrestrained will. ⚠️ THE VEIL FRACTION IS WHY IT BEHAVES THE WAY IT DOES: wild nanite alone would be merely unordered, and unordered is not the same as LUCKY. Desire in the substrate is what makes it ride.
explains: `wildVariance` — ⛔ THE VEIL HALF IS WILL, AND WILL IS NOT REPEATABLE. Nothing twice.
widened crit bands BOTH ways (SNG-140) — ⚠️ unrestrained desire overshoots in either direction
⛔ why it thrives in the unreached gaps: thin ground helps the veil half and the nanite half does not care
wild_current._wasAsserted: ⚠️ SNG-140 said 'a distinct deep-power family' and gave no account of WHY it varies. The mix is the account.

living_current.what: ⛔ 'THE QUICK' — THE GREEN CURRENT. Ungoverned nanite that has taken up residence in living tissue, worked by the oldest human method. ⚠️ GROWN, NOT BUILT: the nanite half is why it is a SUBSTRATE and not a mood; the metaphysical half is why it answers a practitioner at all.
explains: ⛔ why Rootkin are `wild_nanite` primary in the allocation and still feel like something else — the OTHER HALF IS METAPHYSICAL and the allocation only records the primary
why it mirrors precursor without being it — ⚠️ IT IS A GROWN SUBSTRATE FACING A BUILT ONE
why it does not appear in dead ground: living tissue is the medium
living_current._wasAsserted: ⚠️ SNG-131 called it 'the nature-keepers' parallel to the fabricated precursor substrate' — which is the right INSTINCT and not an explanation. A parallel needs to be made of something.

theTwoCurrents._whatThisChangesForTheAudit: ⛔ THE SEVEN CRAFTS CARRYING THESE VALUES ARE NOW `combination` WITH A `powerMix`, not exceptions to the four. ⚠️ AND THE which-CHECK'S W1 GATE NO LONGER NEEDS TO SPECIAL-CASE THEM — I taught it to skip `living_current` and `wild_current` as deliberate gates, and the right answer was to make them expressible instead.
theTwoCurrents._theGeneralRule: ⛔ A NAMED 'CURRENT' IS A COMBINATION SOMEBODY HAS NOTICED OFTEN ENOUGH TO NAME. ⚠️ If the audit finds another, express it as a mix rather than adding a source — there are four, and the reason there are four is the two pairs.

seraphic.why: 'Mercy ADMINISTERED from above.' Administration is machinery — the Seraphim run an apparatus and call it grace.

enginewright.why: ⛔ STRUCTURED NANITE AT ITS PRIME. Aesthetic line updated per Erik — was 'the Precursor arts at their most literal', which contradicted this allocation.

syllogist.why: Argument as architecture; a proof is an ordered process and runs like one.

mason.why: ⚠️ Ordered nanite is WORKED MATTER, which is the one immaterial thing a Mason would accept — a load path is real.

lattice.why: Perfect prediction, the binding of possibility. Definitional.

churnfolk.why: Improvised everything, luck-riding, nothing twice. Definitional.

rootkin.why: 'Grown not built, sap and bark.' Wild nanite as growth.

threnodist.why: ⚠️ Tidal, public, ungoverned. Emotion is not an ordered process and the Keening lands on the singer too.

figurist.why: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-15: 'Figurist is ABSTRACT — think art, or math. Abstract is more of a crazy impression, like a WILD DREAM.' ⚠️ I had objected that Formcraft is the most ordered craft on the wheel, and I was anchoring on skills I authored myself ('buildings that are arguments') that Erik notes may not be useful skills anyway. ABSTRACTION IS NOT ORDER — it is the leap, and the leap is wild.

abyssal.why: ⛔ Canon: the demonic/angelic split IS the Precursor disagreement — 'an ancient disagreement between two entities of one people.' Demons draw on the alien source directly.

wright.why: Scaffolds forever, half-built cathedrals. Making at that scale is crystal-assisted, and the waste is the tell.

unmaker.why: Controlled ruin — and what they unmake is largely Precursor work.

blazeborn.why: Glass plains, revelation as violence. Light shaped through crystal.

umbral.why: They live in the deeps, which is where the lattice is buried.

hourkeeper.why: 'Archives that RUN FORWARD.' Only one thing in this world does that.

horizon.why: ⛔ THE WAYGATES. The far step is Precursor tech, and I missed it when I first allocated them body.

somatic.why: Ki, definitional — 'the body as the only instrument.'

cogitant.why: ⛔ Psychic. Erik 2026-08-15, overturning his own earlier worked example.

verist.why: Seeing truly, without an instrument between.

veilwright.why: ⚠️ Veil folded INTO metaphysical per Erik's grouping (Veil/Psychic/Ki). Resolves 'veil primary for nobody'.

stillhold.why: Inner stillness as a held power, not an absence of one.

marcher.why: ⚠️ Ki-warrior. 'Honed steel, the line that holds' is carried, not drawn.

ashwarden.why: The mercy of stopping needs no apparatus.
